posts.title: [Note] The Worst Possible Way to Email a Link?
posts.description: In order for our youngest kids' school to offer him a 'flu vaccine, they need us to fill out a Web-based consent form. Easy enough. They sent us an email to ask us to fill the form. Did the email show the URL of the form? No. It advised us to open the attached PDF […]

posts.title: [Note] Astroturf Frost
posts.description: When I looked back at the astroturf I only saw one set of frost footprints. And Jesus said "Oh... you didn't expect Me to come, did you? It's fucking freezing out there!"
